status: x-y-time-only kinematic-state feasibility preflight frozen before vertical outcomes
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims
question: Does vertical individuality persist after conditioning not only on horizontal speed but also on path tortuosity/turning intensity?

kinematics.input: x-y-time only; no vertical values used for state construction or preflight selection
kinematics.speed: horizontal Euclidean distance from fix i-1 to i divided by elapsed seconds
kinematics.turn_angle: absolute deflection angle in radians between vectors i-2->i-1 and i-1->i, mapped to [0, pi]
kinematics.event_assignment: fix i receives a kinematic state only when both adjacent step intervals are positive and <=1800 s
kinematics.cohort_thresholds: all speed and turn thresholds are estimated from pooled valid kinematic endpoints within the frozen cohort

feasibility.target_support: A target kinematic endpoint is supported when its 5-km cell × kinematic-state stratum occurs in at least one other session of the same individual and in at least one session of at least one other individual in the same cohort.
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one retained target session has >=50 supported kinematic endpoints
feasibility.selection_rule: Choose the first candidate in priority order for which every primary panel retains at least 70% of its speed-state baseline evaluable individuals and at least 5 individuals. If none passes, stop this mechanism family before opening vertical outcomes.

planned_test_if_feasible.behavioural_mixture_hypothesis: Whole-session vertical individuality is largely induced by stable individual differences in the proportions of broad kinematic modes.
planned_test_if_feasible.within_kinematic_state_hypothesis: Individual centered vertical organization remains non-exchangeable even when self and other profiles are evaluated under identical 5-km cell × speed × turning-state composition.
planned_test_if_feasible.estimator: P(centered residual height | 5-km cell, selected kinematic state), with equal-session self profiles, equal-individual other profiles and identical self-derived joint-stratum weights.
planned_test_if_feasible.calibration: Reuse panel-specific whole-session permutation counts and seeds already frozen for centered-shape/state-conditioned analyses.
planned_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight-selected evaluable n; calibrated identity > 0; one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05
planned_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 4 or 5 PASS => broad kinematic-mode composition alone is insufficient as a general explanation; 2 or 3 => mixed; 0 or 1 => kinematic mixture may explain much of the signal subject to support/power.

claim_boundary: Speed × turning states are kinematic proxies, not validated commuting, foraging or social behavioural states.
Persistence within kinematic states does not prove morphology, memory, learning, resource specialization or personality.
Loss of significance can reflect support loss and is not alone proof of behavioural-mixture causation.
This extension remains outside the frozen v0.3.8 submission package.
stop_rule: Do not change dt cap, turn definition, candidate order, quantile thresholds, 70% retention rule, >=5 floor, 50-event support rule, or 5-km cell after preflight output is opened.
Do not inspect vertical outcomes while selecting the kinematic-state definition.
If no candidate passes, stop rather than simplifying further or dropping a panel after seeing preflight results.
